# Bundle

A bundle is a named list of packs delivered as one download, in `danbyte/bundles/<id>/bundle.yaml`. It has no entries of its own. `danbyte-lib build-pack` turns it into one zip holding each included pack as a complete pack folder; Danbyte installs the packs in it one by one and records each as its own pack. A bundle must include every pack its packs require.

Schema: [`danbyte/schema/bundle.schema.json`](../../schema/bundle.schema.json) (danbyte-library/v1).

Files: `danbyte/bundles/<id>/bundle.yaml`. Start each with the editor line, so VS Code (YAML extension) completes and checks keys as you type:

```yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=<relative path to>/danbyte/schema/bundle.schema.json
```

## Keys

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | `"danbyte-library/v1"` |  |  |
| `id` | string (pattern) | yes | The bundle's id, the same as its folder. Never the id of a pack. |
| `name` | string | yes | The name shown for the download. |
| `description` | string |  | One sentence on what the bundle holds. |
| `version` | string |  | Leave out to take the highest version among its packs. |
| `includes` | list of string (pattern) | yes | The packs in the bundle, by id, in the order Danbyte installs them: a pack after the ones it requires. |

Example:

```yaml
format: danbyte-library/v1
id: cisco-catalyst
name: Cisco Catalyst
includes: [generic-connectors, cisco-optics, cisco-catalyst-9300]
```
